Nora Shah: Kicking off a short-run preview with HelioSilicon (Helio-A1). NDA signed; partner asked for a lightweight public "preview" card and joint blog after benching. Need bench window, telemetry sampling, and embargo alignment.
Diego Rivera: Can they ship images by Tue? I want to validate our kv-cache and streaming path on their board.
Grace Lin: I'll scope a compact harness: correctness, prefix-cache hit-rate, streaming latency. Proposed preview gates: rwd-13b p50<80ms p95<300ms @6k context. Also capture cold-starts separately.
Legal Bot: NDA status: executed. Partner requested a 5-day internal notice before public assets. Recommend we map dates accordingly.
Nora Shah: Bench Lab, can you reserve a short slot Wed 22:00-00:00 UTC? Partner prefers overnight.
Bench Lab: Reserved Wed 22:00-00:00 UTC. Upload config to /drive/helio/a1-eap-configs. bench job queued: HL-A1-EAP-3001, logs at /runs/HL-A1-EAP-3001.
Diego Rivera: I'll push a runtime fallback to `helio-a1-quant` in case of OOM and wire token-level sampling at 0.75%. command for bench: `./run_small --target helio-a1 --model rwd-13b --ctx 6144 --warmup 400 --samples 120 --cold-start`
Nora Shah: Actionables: Grace run bench + upload artifacts (Due: Thu EOD), Diego add fallback + telemetry (Due: Wed), I'll draft preview copy and confirm embargo window with partner (Due: Thu). Quick sync Tue 10:00 PT if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
